description:
Upstream exposes `isKeyRelease(data)` and `isKeyRepeat(data)` functions, and the TUI filters out key release events by default (only forwarding them to components that set `wantsKeyRelease: true`). Our KeyParser correctly parses Kitty event types into `Key.event_type` (`:press`, `:repeat`, `:release`), but Interactive.handle_event never checks `event_type` — it processes releases and repeats identically to presses.

Once Kitty protocol is enabled (ticket 1), release events will fire for every keyup, causing double-handling of every keystroke.

Implement: in Interactive.handle_event, filter out `:release` events (and optionally `:repeat` unless the component opts in). This should be a simple guard at the top of the key dispatch chain.

Ref: `tui.ts` L567-568.
title: KeyParser: key release and repeat event filtering
